news.headline: Duke beats Tulane 17-3 in the opener
news.summary: Tulane's offense never got going Saturday at Duke and the Green Wave managed only a field goal. Duke running back Nate Sheppard carried the ball 35 times for 227 yards and two touchdowns.

news.headline: Storms push back Tulane's opener at Duke
news.summary: Bad weather in Durham held up Saturday's game and the stadium was cleared for a while. Kickoff moved from 2:30 to 4:00 our time.

news.headline: Tulane practices on grass to get ready for Duke
news.summary: The Green Wave held their last tune-up practice Friday at the Saints facility so they could work on a real grass field. Duke's stadium has grass, and Tulane opens there on September 5.

news.headline: Florida wins big in Jon Sumrall's first game
news.summary: The Gators beat Florida Atlantic 66-21 on Saturday night in a sold-out stadium. Jadan Baugh ran for 160 yards and three touchdowns, and Aaron Philo threw for 275 yards.

news.headline: Florida's opener Saturday is sold out
news.summary: Florida says every seat is taken for the Florida Atlantic game. It is the 19th home game in a row that has sold out.

news.headline: Florida is healthy going into Saturday's opener
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Tuesday that the Gators are pretty healthy and almost everyone is ready to play. Walk-on running back Kelvin Jimenez is out for the year, and tight end Evan Chieca is questionable.

news.headline: Arch Manning throws four touchdown passes
news.summary: Texas opened the season Saturday with a 59-7 win over Texas State in Austin. Manning threw for 305 yards and four touchdowns before he came out of the game in the third quarter.

news.headline: Trevor Goosby will play in Saturday's opener
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Thursday that his left tackle is good to go after a bruised knee. Texas will watch how many plays he takes because it will be hot on Saturday afternoon.

news.headline: Four Texas home games move up a week
news.summary: Texas said four future home games will now be played a week earlier, starting with New Mexico State on August 28, 2027. College football will begin a week sooner from next season on.

news.headline: Tyler Shough is the Saints starting quarterback
news.summary: The Saints put out their lineup chart Friday for the opener at Detroit. Tyler Shough is the starter, Spencer Rattler is behind him, and Travis Etienne Jr. and Alvin Kamara are both listed first at running back.

news.headline: Saints let go of two hurt players
news.summary: The Saints released running back Devin Neal and pass rusher Michael Heldman, who were both hurt in the preseason. The team paid them for their recovery time, and it can sign them again later.

news.headline: Saints claim a cornerback off waivers
news.summary: New Orleans picked up cornerback Decamerion Richardson from Las Vegas on Wednesday. Safety Lorenzo Styles Jr. went on injured reserve, and wide receiver Kevin Austin Jr. and tight end Treyton Welch joined the practice squad.

news.headline: IUP sweeps Lake Erie for its fourth win in a row
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-23, 25-16 and 25-14 on Saturday at home. Charlotte Potvin had 11 kills, Delaney Concannon had 15 digs, and IUP is now 5-3.

news.headline: IUP beats Daemen to finish a perfect weekend
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks lost the first set Saturday at home and then won the next three, 25-20, 25-19 and 25-18. They went 4-0 in their own tournament, and Delaney Concannon had 19 kills and 20 digs.

news.headline: IUP beats Ashland in four sets at home
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks lost the first set 26-24 on Friday and then won the next three. Delaney Concannon had a season-best 20 kills, Jessica Neiman had 18, and IUP is now 4-3.

news.headline: Yankees beat the Padres 5-1 in San Diego
news.summary: New York scored four runs in the second inning Saturday and never trailed. Carlos Rodon gave up one run in five innings, and the Yankees are now 81-61.

news.headline: Padres beat the Yankees on a 10th inning home run
news.summary: Luis Campusano hit a two-run home run in the 10th inning Friday night in San Diego and the Padres won 3-2. New York is now four games behind first-place Tampa Bay.

news.headline: Yankees win in extra innings in Anaheim
news.summary: New York scored five runs with two outs in the 10th inning Wednesday night and beat the Angels 6-3. Cam Schlittler pitched eight innings and gave up just one run.
